kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the block's header + roster + ten-row application matrix + adverse-effects row + four-row selectivity subtable.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the table; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The FOUR-LANE SELECTIVITY frame — the printed selectivity subtable read as one question asked of every -olol: WHICH RECEPTORS does it block? β1-SELECTIVE (atenolol, betaxolol, bisoprolol, esmolol, metoprolol — the book's own 'A to M (β1 with 1st half of alphabet)' mnemonic) vs NONSELECTIVE (nadolol, propranolol, timolol — 'N to Z (β2 with 2nd half of alphabet)') vs COMBINED β+α1 (carvedilol, labetalol — the book's own 'modified suffixes (instead of "-olol")' rule) vs NEBIVOLOL (β1 + β3-NO — 'NebivOlol increases NO'). All four mnemonics are the BOOK'S OWN print; the four-lane compression that turns four printed memory hooks into one sorting question is KYP's.
kypExtensions.rationale: The selectivity rows and all four mnemonic cells are printed; the unified four-lane reading frame is KYP's synthesis.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + mechanisms[0] + the visual's four fork cards

kypExtensions.summary: The THREE CAUTION PATIENTS frame — the printed adverse-effects row read as three patients the β-blocker endangers: THE ASTHMATIC ('asthma/COPD exacerbations' — nonselective β2 blockade unopposes bronchoconstriction; the 'avoid nonselective agents in asthma' management rule is KYP's, flagged — the printed cell names the exacerbation, not the avoidance rule), THE BRITTLE DIABETIC ('masked hypoglycemia' — β2 blockade blunts the liver's glycogenolysis and hides the tachycardia warning sign; the tachycardia-masking reading is KYP's, flagged), and THE COCAINE USER (the printed 'unsubstantiated concern for unopposed α-adrenergic stimulation' note — the controversy the book itself hedges). The cells are printed; the three-patient sort and the management rules are KYP's.
kypExtensions.rationale: The adverse-effect cells and the cocaine note are printed; the three-patient framing and the avoidance rules are KYP's clinical overlay.
kypExtensions.location: usmle patterns[0] + traps[0-2] + the miniCase + the visual's toxicity strip

kypExtensions.summary: Two protocol frames (both NOT printed on this page — flagged wherever used): (1) the ABRUPT-WITHDRAWAL frame — never stop a β-blocker cold (rebound tachycardia, angina, hypertension, arrhythmia; taper over days to weeks) — the block's printed cells carry no withdrawal token; (2) the PHEO α-FIRST frame — in pheochromocytoma, α-blockade before β-blockade (book 243's phenoxybenzamine row is the printed anchor; THIS page prints only the unopposed-α concern in its cocaine note) — a β-blocker first leaves the catecholamine surge on unopposed α1 receptors. Both rules are classic exam material, both absent from the printed cells, both KYP-flagged and anchored to printed lines (phenoxybenzamine row + cocaine note) rather than cited as print.
kypExtensions.rationale: Neither the taper rule nor the pheo ordering rule prints on book 244; both are clinical-pharmacology standards attached as flagged overlays.
kypExtensions.location: usmle traps[3] + pivots[0] + the visual's caution strip

kypExtensions.summary: The boundary + absence census itself: (1) the PH23/PH24 boundary — pdf 266 (book 244) carries the WHOLE β-blockers block (header, roster, ten-row application matrix, adverse row, four-row selectivity subtable, footer); pdf 265 behind carries the two COMPLETED book-243 blocks (only the α-blockers table's phenoxybenzamine row and final row pinned from behind as markers); pdf 267 ahead opens 'Phosphodiesterase inhibitors' (the PENDING next topic) — sourcePages = [266] only. (2) The ABSENCE verification: the task's 'partial agonist/ISA: pindolol, acebutolol' and 'α2+β: none' expectations were verified against the 2026 print — the selectivity subtable carries exactly FOUR groups (β1-selective, nonselective β1=β2, combined β+α1, nebivolol-β3/NO); NO partial-agonist/ISA row (pindolol and acebutolol are ABSENT from the page) and NO α2+β member — documented as verified-absent, never cited as printed. (3) The essential-tremor use the task expected is likewise NOT printed on this page (the printed neurology lane is migraine prophylaxis only) — documented absent, KYP-flagged wherever the classic propranolol-for-tremor teaching appears.
